risks.proof: A short video clip of the machine powered on, threading, and stitching or running an embroidery pattern.

risks.proof: Well-lit photos from multiple angles including close-ups of the casing and screen.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the model/serial nameplate on the back or base of the machine.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching or running an embroidery design.
Photo of all accessories included (pedal, power cable, hoops, bobbins, manual).
Well-lit photos of the machine off the bed, showing all sides and any wear.
response.reason: The seller's claimed model (Brother SE630) is the detail that would set the price, but no nameplate or model number is legible in either photo, and no proof of working condition or accessories is shown.
